protocol.direct_recurrent_source_probe: diagnose each emitted target context as the next step's W_prev
protocol.same_token_collision_model: measured grouped-pair intersections; physical overlap is exactly twice winner-pair overlap

selection.rule: first listed arm with every learned context active, zero learned-code collisions, max learned target winner-pair overlap below ceil(theta_match/2) in every seed, zero direct recurrent-source matching/active segments, and zero novel false predictions, matching segments, or active segments; every new learned target exposure must also have zero pre-exposure matching/active segments and zero predicted columns across every construction seed
selection.rule_revision_basis: paired-source structural correction after a preliminary synthetic artifact exposed unsafe learned-code overlap
